work_title: Make a test that the UTXO set tree is not modified as a result of proofsForTransactions call
description: Merged upstream: ergoplatform/ergo#2493, merged by kushti on 2026-09-01 (8b7d974). Adds the chain-level invariant the existing tests lack: at every height of a growing chain, proofsForTransactions() leaves the tree root untouched, is repeatable, and the block built from its proofs applies and lands on the promised digest. This replaces #77, the reservation for the same work, which was closed as a stale reservation on 2026-10-14 although the work had been merged on 2026-09-01.
